# SeoTool.im
> All-in-one SEO platform with keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, backlink intelligence, AI visibility monitoring, and white-label reporting.

## Core Features
- [Keyword Intelligence](https://seotool.im/#features): Accurate search volumes, keyword difficulty, and intent clustering powered by DataForSEO real-time indexes.
- [SERP Rank Tracking](https://seotool.im/#features): Daily keyword positions across Google and Bing with volatility detection and competitor moves.
- [Technical Site Audits](https://seotool.im/#features): Automated crawler inspecting 100+ technical SEO factors, Core Web Vitals, and indexability.
- [Backlink Intelligence](https://seotool.im/#features): Referring domains, anchor distribution, toxic spam scores, and competitor link intersect.
- [AI Visibility & Citations](https://seotool.im/#features): Track brand mentions across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.
- [Content Quality & Gaps](https://seotool.im/#features): Content scoring, semantic entity extraction, and domain gap analysis.
- [White-Label PDF Reports](https://seotool.im/#features): Client-ready branded reports on automated schedules.
- [SAM Agent & MCP Tools](https://seotool.im/#features): Autonomous SEO agent and 36+ native MCP tools for Claude Desktop and IDEs.

## Key Pages
- [Pricing](https://seotool.im/pricing): Progressive cohort pricing. Early members lock in a lower rate forever.
- [Documentation](https://seotool.im/docs): Guides, API reference, and MCP tool documentation.
- [Blog](https://seotool.im/blogs): SEO insights, product updates, and industry analysis.

- 36+ native MCP agent tools
